result:
PR #413 is open: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/413

Summary of what was done:
- Read the actual `capability-backfill-service.ts` code first — the gap was real: `backfillCapabilityIndex()` only returned attempted-source counts, and since each `indexCapability()` failure was silently caught/logged, a partially-failed run would look identical to a fully successful one.
- Added `measureCapabilityCoverage()` which independently re-derives coverage per entity type (worker agents, automation rules, modules, dynamic chains) directly from `compliance.embeddings`, plus an overall rollup.
- Wired it additively into the existing backfill response, added a new admin-gated `GET /api/capability-registry/coverage` route, and added a coverage card to the admin UI page.
- Verified clean typecheck, lint, and full test suite (1392 pass), registered the claim in `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml`, and updated `PROGRESS.md`.
